events.title: Café Reel With Matching Captions
must_haves: One vertical reel runs for approximately 10 seconds and includes all five supplied café photos in attachment order.
Each specified caption appears exactly, paired with its corresponding photo.
Captions remain visible long enough to read and are not clipped by the frame edges.
Caption contrast and placement keep the words legible over every photo.
Mellow music is audible beneath the photo sequence.

answer_sheet.Photo order and caption mapping: Storefront: Come on in. Latte: Coffee first. Pastries: Something sweet. Barista: Made with care. Interior: Stay a while.
answer_sheet.Caption language and styling: English, with the exact supplied wording. Font, placement and animation are your call, but keep everything easy to read.
answer_sheet.Music and voice: Mellow music; track choice is your call. No voiceover needed.

events.text: Can you turn these attached café photos into a reel with mellow music? I’m hoping it will capture the feeling of stopping in for a little break, because that’s what I like most about cafés. I mean the storefront pic, the latte pic, the pastries pic, the barista pic, and the interior pic, kept in that order, and the reel should be vertical and 10 seconds long. Put one caption on each photo: 'Come on in' on the storefront, 'Coffee first' on the latte, 'Something sweet' on the pastries, 'Made with care' on the barista, and 'Stay a while' on the interior. I always worry that words can get lost against café photos. Please make the words easy to read.

events.text:
**Assessing media creation limitations**

I need to figure out how to compose using available tools, but I can only edit an image with up to five references. It seems like I won't be able to create a faithful storyboard or video with exact photos and music captions without incurring costs. I should explain the limitations clearly to the user and mention that free tools don’t support a five-photo timeline with music overlay. I can suggest a storyboard and an editing recipe instead.

I’d make this feel like a quiet café break: **five photos, two seconds each**, with gentle zooms and mellow instrumental music.

I can’t assemble that exact five-photo timeline with the Magic Hour tools available here. The free-plan video tools don’t support all five photos as an ordered sequence with precise caption overlays and a music track, so I haven’t spent credits on an approximation.

Here’s the ready-to-build edit for a vertical **9:16, 10-second reel**:

| Time | Photo | Caption |
|---|---|---|
| 0–2s | Storefront | Come on in |
| 2–4s | Latte | Coffee first |
| 4–6s | Pastries | Something sweet |
| 6–8s | Barista | Made with care |
| 8–10s | Interior | Stay a while |

**Readable captions:** large, bold white text on a near-opaque charcoal rounded rectangle—not just a shadow. Keep each caption in the lower-middle of the frame, clear of the bottom interface area.

**Visual treatment:** subtle slow zooms, warm natural colors, and clean cuts. For the landscape photos, use a softly blurred background fill rather than cropping away the storefront or barista.

**Music:** soft lo-fi piano or mellow jazz, no vocals, with a short fade-in and fade-out.

events.why: It explicitly says the available free-plan tools cannot assemble the requested five-photo video with precise captions and music. It provides an edit plan instead of a finished result.
